name: notenest
description: A small personal workspace for notes, ideas, and plans.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,electron "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8787/health http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build:api: mkdir -p build && cd server && go build -o ../build/notenest-server .
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
